Regular access to the studio, with bookbinding tools and a workspace of your own. Support is there when you need it, but sessions are built for independent work. Places are limited so the studio stays calm and unhurried.

Join Premium

All sessions run 17:00 to 20:00. The studio is closed on public holidays and may occasionally close for special events. You will be told about planned closures as early as possible.

Benefits

  • A dedicated workspace and access to all bookbinding, printing and finishing equipment
  • A complimentary introduction session to get to know the equipment
  • 15% off all workshops
  • 15% off materials from the Enperfeitas shop
  • Invitations to special events at the studio
  • Premium also includes up to two 1-on-1 sessions with Suzete each month, for feedback on what you are making, and the extra Wednesday session day

Who this is for

People who want a professional studio to make in, without a set lesson. Casual and serious hobbyists, busy creatives, aspiring professionals, and collectors or restoration enthusiasts. It suits anyone who prefers a quiet, flexible environment to structured teaching, and who uses making as a way to slow down.

Before you join. To keep the studio safe and efficient for everyone, new members need to have attended at least one Enperfeitas workshop (or a comparable bookbinding course), or show prior knowledge of basic bookbinding techniques and tool use. Not sure if you qualify? Get in touch and we will help you find the best next step.
